theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months expenses, protecting you from unexpected financial shocks and reducing stress.
caption: Before investing, establish an emergency corpus. The 50/30/20 rule helps: 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings. Distinguish between productive debt and consumer debt. #EmergencyFund #BudgetingBasics #PersonalFinance #DebtManagement #FinancialWellness
